expectations.evidence: TaskExecutor trait. Four impls: ShellExecutor, HttpExecutor, DockerExecutor, ClosureExecutor. Trait-based, not enum.
Each executor holds its own config. ShellExecutor{command}, HttpExecutor{url,method,headers}, DockerExecutor{image,env,cmd}.
Scheduler works with Box<dyn TaskExecutor>. No knowledge of specific executor types. Also uses Decorator pattern: RetryExecutor wraps any executor to add retry transparently.
Adding K8sExecutor = new struct + impl TaskExecutor. Scheduler, retry, timeout, existing executors all untouched. RetryExecutor wraps any new executor automatically via builder.
